title: HARD-01: Security review of v1 against SECURITY.md (Appendix C)
body:
**Source:** Original roadmap phase 012 (postponed by owner decision 2026-10-17)

**Current state (v1):** Rules were applied phase by phase; no end-to-end audit has been done.

**Proposed work:** Walk every S-* rule, record evidence or gaps, fix gaps, and complete `docs/THREAT_MODEL.md` (S-TEST-04).

title: HARD-02: Long fuzzing campaign for every parser
body:
**Source:** S-TEST-01; phases 002–V1-C ran 5–10 minutes per target

**Current state (v1):** Targets parse_layout, ini, html, url, highlight, math and mermaid exist; each ran only minutes.

**Proposed work:** Run each target for ≥ 1 hour (nightly or a manual workflow); turn every crash into a regression test.

title: HARD-03: Re-verify ACG and binary hardening on real Windows
body:
**Source:** F-06 (Phase 002) and ADR-0001; items marked NOT VERIFIED

**Current state (v1):** ProcessDynamicCodePolicy is on. Not verified on a real PC: shell-extension-heavy folders in the Open dialog, drag & drop, IME composition. ICO/WebP fail under ACG (FUT-48).

**Proposed work:** Test on real Windows 10 and 11 machines; adjust the policy or record exceptions in an ADR.

title: HARD-04: Keyboard reachability of every control
body:
**Source:** R-A11Y-01; Phase 003b report

**Current state (v1):** Tab focus order covers links only; code-toolbar buttons and other interactive elements are not reachable by keyboard.

**Proposed work:** Add every interactive element (code toolbar, task boxes, callout fold, front-matter toggle, details summary, sidebar items) to the focus order with a visible focus ring. UIA and High Contrast are FUT-47.

title: PERF-01: Meet the final memory budgets (Appendix D, final column)
body:
**Source:** Original roadmap phase 013 (postponed); D.2

**Current state (v1):** CI soft-budget values: M0 2.28 MiB, M1 4.65 MiB (final ≤ 5.0), M2 5.60 MiB, M5 F3 5.70 MiB (final ≤ 6.0). Measured only on a GPU-less CI VM.

**Proposed work:** Measure on real hardware; make the final column hard CI gates; reduce image memory (DIB vs DDB study, FUT-42).

title: PERF-02: Open-file dialog latency (T-DLG ≤ 400 ms)
body:
**Source:** F-09 dialog host (Phase 003)

**Current state (v1):** 484–583 ms on CI runners: process start plus comdlg32/shell start-up in the out-of-process dialog host.

**Proposed work:** Measure on real hardware; consider pre-spawning the host at idle (watch the RAM cost).

title: PERF-03: Cold scroll p99 on typical documents
body:
**Source:** Phases V1-A–V1-C measurements

**Current state (v1):** Warm p99 is about 14 ms (gate 16 ms); cold p99 reached 37.2 ms (target ≤ 33 ms).

**Proposed work:** Cache scaled image bitmaps and code-block rasters; paint only intersecting rects; re-measure on real hardware.

title: PERF-04: Mermaid scroll p99 close to the gate
body:
**Source:** Phase V1-C report

**Current state (v1):** Warm p99 15.47 ms (gate 16 ms), cold 24.09 ms on `mermaid-heavy.md`.

**Proposed work:** Cache rasters of visible diagrams inside the image LRU budget.

title: PERF-05: Binary size and opt-level review
body:
**Source:** D.2 B-SIZE; release profile note "revisit opt-level"

**Current state (v1):** yamdv.exe is 2.50 MiB (final ≤ 3.0 MiB, stretch 2.0 MiB) with opt-level "s".

**Proposed work:** Run `cargo bloat`; compare opt-level s/z/3 for size, speed and memory; trim tables if needed.

title: PERF-06: Incremental re-render for live reload
body:
**Source:** R-REN-18, R-READ-01; Phase V1-A

**Current state (v1):** An external file change triggers a full re-parse (scroll anchor kept). Editing already uses incremental reparse.

**Proposed work:** Reuse the editor's splice path for external changes so only changed blocks are re-parsed and re-laid out.

title: PERF-07: Flaky performance gates on GitHub-hosted runners
body:
**Source:** Phases V1-A–V1-D CI history

**Current state (v1):** Hosted runners vary a lot: T4 spikes to 26 ms, occasional T7/M0/M1 failures on unchanged code. Mitigated by the two-attempt retry rule.

**Proposed work:** Measure on stable hardware (real PC or self-hosted runner on a private fork) or switch to relative thresholds.

title: BUG-01: Ctrl+click on a link with #fragment opens the new window at the top
body:
**Source:** Phase 003b report

**Current state (v1):** The new window ignores the `#fragment` of the target.

**Proposed work:** Scroll the new window to the anchor after load.

title: BUG-02: Single-line `$$…$$` with an error is not shown as display math
body:
**Source:** Phase V1-C report

**Current state (v1):** `$$\frac{a}{$$` on one line is not recognised as display math, so it renders as plain text instead of in the error style.

**Proposed work:** Handle the single-line error case in the Markdown front end.

title: BUG-03: Copy as Markdown is not exact for reference links and autolinks
body:
**Source:** Phase 003 report

**Current state (v1):** Copy as Markdown expands the selection by markers, not by the AST.

**Proposed work:** Map the selection through the parser's source ranges so the copied slice is exact.

title: BUG-04: HTML: only a common subset of named entities is decoded
body:
**Source:** Phase 003 report

**Current state (v1):** Numeric entities all work; named entities are a common subset.

**Proposed work:** Generate the full HTML5 named-entity table at build time (static data).

title: BUG-05: HTML tables: rowspan is treated as 1
body:
**Source:** Phase 003 report (allowed as MAY)

**Current state (v1):** `colspan` works, `rowspan` is ignored.

**Proposed work:** Support rowspan in the HTML table model.

title: BUG-06: Tables: multi-line cell content aligns the cell box, not each line
body:
**Source:** Phase 003 report

**Current state (v1):** Per-column alignment is applied to the cell box.

**Proposed work:** Apply the column alignment to every line inside wrapped cells.

title: BUG-07: `==highlight==` cannot cross emphasis; escaped text skips inline extensions
body:
**Source:** Phase 003 report

**Current state (v1):** Highlight pairs cannot cross emphasis boundaries; text containing escapes or entities skips the inline extension pass.

**Proposed work:** Run the extension pass on the event stream with source ranges instead of plain text runs.

title: BUG-08: Wide flowcharts become too small to read
body:
**Source:** Phase V1-C report

**Current state (v1):** Diagrams are scaled down to fit the column; a 9-node LR row becomes tiny. The fullscreen viewer is FUT-36.

**Proposed work:** Stop shrinking below a minimum scale and scroll the card horizontally instead.

title: BUG-09: Popup menu does not match B.7.1 styling
body:
**Source:** Phase V1-A report

**Current state (v1):** Menus are Win32 owner-drawn menus: no rounded corners, custom shadow or fade from B.7.1.

**Proposed work:** Implement the layered custom popup menu from B.7.1 (cosmetic).

title: QA-01: Real-hardware QA of v1 (items never verified on a real PC)
body:
**Source:** NOT VERIFIED items in the phase 001–V1-D reports

**Current state (v1):** All automated checks ran on a GPU-less Windows Server VM at 1024×768.

**Proposed work:** Verify on a real Windows 10/11 PC: per-monitor DPI and 150 % scaling (document, split view, formulas, diagrams); live dark/light switch; default-app switch through Windows Settings; Explorer "Open with YAMDV"; drag & drop; Turkish Q layout incl. AltGr and dead keys; CJK IME; Save-as from the conflict dialog; ClearType in Cambria Math; WebP/ICO codec availability; Export PDF via Microsoft Print to PDF; install / uninstall.

title: DEC-01: Choose a license for the public repository
body:
**Source:** LICENSE placeholder since Phase 001; repository made public 2026-10-17

**Current state (v1):** LICENSE says "All rights reserved": the code is visible but others may not use it.

**Proposed work:** Owner decides: keep proprietary, or an open-source license (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0).

title: IDEA-01: Code signing to avoid SmartScreen warnings
body:
**Source:** SmartScreen notes in OWNER_KIT.md and README

**Current state (v1):** The exe is unsigned, so Windows shows SmartScreen warnings on first run.

**Proposed work:** Evaluate a signing certificate or a managed signing service; sign release builds in the release job.

title: IDEA-02: Distribution via a winget manifest
body:
**Source:** Not in the original spec

**Current state (v1):** Users download a zip from a GitHub release.

**Proposed work:** Publish a winget manifest pointing at the release zip (after signing and licensing are decided).

title: IDEA-03: Windows ARM64 build
body:
**Source:** Hard rule H4 ("x64 only")

**Current state (v1):** Only x86_64-pc-windows-msvc is built.

**Proposed work:** Add an aarch64-pc-windows-msvc build and test it on ARM hardware.

title: IDEA-04: Offline spell checking with the Windows spell-checker API
body:
**Source:** Non-goal in SPEC A.0 ("maybe later")

**Current state (v1):** No spell checking in F2/F3.

**Proposed work:** Use ISpellChecker (offline, OS-provided) for squiggles and suggestions in edit modes.
